verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server and says Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools can connect to search and manage the workspace. It also offers a public REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a standard Deal object, and full interaction history, so an agent can pull deals and history to compile a brief; Attio's own AI also explicitly 'creates account briefs.' missing for 10: no documentation that recent emails are exposed through the API or MCP tools, no detailed list of MCP tools or what they return, and no independent or hands-on confirmation that an agent can assemble a pre-meeting brief.
